exercises.name: Deep Belly Breath
instructions: Sit or lie down in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on your chest and one on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose for 4 counts, letting your belly rise.
Hold for 2 counts.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for 6 counts.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
instructions: Sit comfortably with your back straight.
Exhale completely to start.
Inhale through your nose for 4 counts.
Hold for 4 counts.
Exhale through your mouth for 4 counts.
Hold for 4 counts.
Repeat the cycle.

exercises.name: Neck Side Stretch
instructions: Sit up straight with shoulders relaxed.
Gently tilt your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Hold for 15 seconds, feeling the stretch on the left side of your neck.
Return to center.
Repeat on the left side.
exercises.caution: Move slowly and never force your neck. Skip if you have a neck injury, recent whiplash, or numbness/tingling in your arms.

exercises.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back flat.
Reach your hands toward the floor, bending knees slightly if needed.
Hold for 20–30 seconds.
Slowly roll back up to standing.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Flow
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale: drop your belly, lift your chest and tailbone (Cow pose).
Exhale: round your spine toward the ceiling, tucking chin and pelvis (Cat pose).
Flow slowly between the two, following your breath.
Repeat 8–10 times.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist
instructions: Sit cross-legged on the floor.
Place your right hand behind you and your left hand on your right knee.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale and gently twist to the right.
Hold for 20 seconds.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your big toes touching.
Sit back on your heels and lower your torso forward.
Extend your arms overhead on the floor, or rest them alongside your body.
Relax your forehead to the mat.
Hold and breathe deeply for the full duration.

exercises.name: Shoulder Roll
instructions: Sit or stand comfortably.
Lift both shoulders toward your ears.
Roll them back and down in a slow circle.
Complete 5 backward rolls, then 5 forward rolls.

exercises.name: 4-7-8 Breathing
instructions: Sit with your back straight. Place your tongue behind your upper front teeth.
Exhale completely through your mouth.
Inhale quietly through your nose for 4 counts.
Hold your breath for 7 counts.
Exhale completely through your mouth for 8 counts.
This completes one cycle. Repeat 3–4 times.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel on your right knee with your left foot forward.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch in the front of your right hip.
Keep your torso upright and core engaged.
Hold for 30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Opener
instructions: Stand in a doorway and place your forearms on each side of the frame.
Position your elbows at shoulder height, bent at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward and gently lean through the doorway.
Feel the stretch across your chest and front shoulders.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, then relax.
exercises.caution: Don't push into shoulder pain. Avoid if you have a shoulder injury or instability.

exercises.name: Seated Figure-Four Stretch
instructions: Sit on the edge of a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Cross your right ankle over your left knee, forming a figure 4.
Flex your right foot to protect your knee.
Gently press down on your right knee and lean forward slightly.
Hold for 30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
instructions: Extend your right arm in front of you with the palm facing up.
Use your left hand to gently pull your fingers back toward you.
Hold for 15–20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the inner forearm.
Release and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
instructions: Stand on your left leg, holding a wall or chair for balance if needed.
Bend your right knee and grasp your right ankle behind you.
Keep your knees together and stand tall.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch along the front of your thigh.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch at Wall
instructions: Stand facing a wall with your hands flat against it.
Step your right foot back into a lunge, keeping the heel flat on the floor.
Keep your back leg straight and lean toward the wall.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your calf.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck (Forward Head Reset)
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Gently retract your chin straight back — as if making a 'double chin'.
Hold for 3–5 seconds.
Release and repeat 10 times.
This resets the cervical spine and reduces forward-head posture.

exercises.name: Alternate Nostril Breathing
instructions: Sit comfortably. Rest your left hand on your lap.
Bring your right hand to your face. Place your index and middle fingers on your forehead.
Close your right nostril with your thumb. Inhale slowly through the left nostril for 4 counts.
Close your left nostril with your ring finger. Open your right nostril and exhale for 4 counts.
Inhale through the right nostril for 4 counts.
Close the right nostril and exhale through the left for 4 counts.
This completes one cycle. Repeat for the full duration.

exercises.name: Pursed Lip Breathing
instructions: Sit comfortably and relax your neck and shoulders.
Inhale slowly through your nose for 2 counts.
Pucker or 'purse' your lips as if you are going to whistle.
Exhale slowly through pursed lips for 4 counts.
Repeat for the full duration.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Arm Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Bring your right arm across your chest at shoulder height.
Use your left forearm to press your right arm gently closer to your chest.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch in the back of your shoulder.
Release and repeat on the other side.
exercises.caution: Stop if you feel shoulder pinching. Avoid if you have a rotator-cuff injury.

exercises.name: Wrist Circles
instructions: Extend both arms in front of you with hands loosely balled into fists.
Slowly rotate your wrists in large circles — 10 times clockwise.
Reverse direction for 10 circles counter-clockwise.
Shake your hands out gently to finish.

exercises.name: Standing Side Stretch
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Raise your right arm overhead and place your left hand on your hip.
Lean gently to the left, reaching your right arm over in an arc.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch along your right side.
Return to center and switch sides.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Press your feet into the floor and squeeze your glutes.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Hold for 2–3 seconds at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat for 10–15 reps.

exercises.name: Supine Knee-to-Chest
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended.
Draw your right knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your left leg flat on the floor (or bent for comfort).
Hold for 20–30 seconds, breathing deeply.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat, arms relaxed at sides.
Inhale to prepare.
Exhale: gently flatten your lower back into the floor by tightening your abdominals.
Hold for 5 counts, then release.
Inhale as you return to the neutral curve.
Repeat 10–15 times rhythmically with your breath.

exercises.name: Ankle Alphabet
instructions: Sit in a chair with your right foot lifted off the floor.
Using your big toe as a pointer, trace each letter of the alphabet in the air.
Move only from the ankle — keep your leg still.
Finish the full alphabet, then switch to the left foot.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
instructions: Stand or sit tall.
Raise your right arm overhead, then bend your elbow to reach your right hand toward your left shoulder blade.
Use your left hand to gently press your right elbow back and down.
Hold for 20 seconds, feeling the stretch along the back of your upper arm.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: Happy Baby Pose
instructions: Lie on your back and draw both knees toward your chest.
Grab the outside edges of your feet (or your ankles or shins).
Open your knees wider than your torso and pull them toward your armpits.
Flex your feet so soles face upward.
Rock gently side to side if it feels good. Hold and breathe deeply.

exercises.name: Legs Up the Wall
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall, then swing your legs up as you lie back.
Rest your legs vertically against the wall with your back flat on the floor.
Let your arms rest comfortably at your sides, palms up.
Breathe slowly and deeply, allowing your body to relax completely.
Stay for up to 5 minutes. To come out, slide your knees to one side first.

exercises.name: Lion's Breath
instructions: Kneel or sit comfortably. Place your hands on your knees.
Inhale deeply through your nose.
Open your mouth wide, stretch your tongue out and down toward your chin.
Exhale forcefully through your mouth, making a 'haaaa' sound.
At the same time, open your eyes wide and look between your eyebrows.
Relax and repeat 5–8 times.
exercises.caution: Skip if you have jaw (TMJ) issues. Stop if you feel lightheaded.

exercises.name: Eye Palming
instructions: Rub your palms together briskly until they feel warm.
Close your eyes and gently cup your palms over them — do not press on the eyeballs.
Breathe slowly and feel the warmth and darkness calming your eyes.
Hold for 30–60 seconds.
Slowly lower your hands and blink your eyes open gently.

exercises.name: Reverse Prayer Hands
instructions: Stand or sit tall. Bring your arms behind your back.
Turn your hands so your fingers point down, then rotate them inward until fingertips point up.
Press your palms together behind your back as much as is comfortable.
Hold for 20–30 seconds, feeling the stretch in your wrists and forearms.
Release gently and shake out your wrists.

exercises.name: Thoracic Open Book
instructions: Lie on your right side with knees stacked and bent to 90 degrees.
Extend both arms forward at shoulder height, palms together.
Inhale, then exhale as you rotate your left arm up and open it to the left, following with your gaze.
Keep your knees stacked and let your upper body rotate — not your hips.
Return to start on the next inhale. Repeat 10 times, then switch sides.
exercises.caution: Ease off if you have a disc problem or sharp back pain. Keep the movement gentle and controlled.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rolls
instructions: Sit upright with shoulders relaxed and hands resting on your thighs.
Drop your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head to the right, bringing your right ear toward your right shoulder.
Continue rolling back to centre and over to the left.
Avoid rolling fully back — keep the movement in the front half of the circle.
Perform 5 slow rolls each direction.

exercises.name: Standing Pigeon at Desk
instructions: Stand facing a desk or table at hip height.
Place your right leg on the desk, bent at the knee in a 90-degree angle.
Flex your right foot to protect your knee.
Stand tall or fold forward over your leg for a deeper stretch.
Hold for 30–45 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit in a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Press the balls of your feet into the floor and lift your heels as high as possible.
Hold at the top for 1–2 seconds.
Lower your heels slowly back to the floor.
Repeat for 15–20 reps to warm up the calves and ankles.
exercises.caution: Hold something stable for balance. Skip if you have an acute ankle or Achilles injury.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breath with Counting
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and one hand on your belly.
Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts, letting your belly rise under your hand.
Exhale slowly through your mouth for 8 counts, letting your belly fall.
Keep your chest as still as possible — only your belly should move.
Repeat for the full duration, focusing on the count.

exercises.name: Triceps & Elbow Stretch
instructions: Reach one arm overhead and bend the elbow, dropping your hand behind your head.
Use the opposite hand to gently draw the elbow inward.
Hold and breathe for 20–30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
exercises.caution: Gentle pressure only. Stop if you feel sharp elbow or shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Wrist & Forearm Release
instructions: Extend one arm forward, palm up.
Use your other hand to gently pull the fingers down and back toward you.
Hold 20 seconds, then flip the palm down and repeat.
Switch arms.
exercises.caution: Ease off if you have carpal tunnel symptoms — numbness or tingling means stop and rest.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended, the other tucked in.
Hinge forward from the hips, reaching toward your toes.
Keep your back long rather than rounding it.
Hold 30 seconds and switch legs.
exercises.caution: Move from the hips and don't bounce. Stop if you feel pain or tingling down the leg (possible sciatica).

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
instructions: Stand facing a wall, hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back, keeping the heel down and the back leg straight.
Lean into the wall until you feel a stretch in the back calf.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch.
exercises.caution: Stop immediately for sudden sharp calf pain or swelling — that needs medical attention.

exercises.name: Shin & Ankle Mobiliser
instructions: Sit tall in a chair.
Slowly point and flex one foot through its full range.
Then circle the ankle 5 times each direction.
Switch feet and repeat.

exercises.name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Cross one ankle over the opposite thigh to make a figure-4.
Reach through and gently pull the back thigh toward your chest.
Hold 30 seconds and switch sides.
exercises.caution: Keep it gentle. Skip if you have a hip replacement or sharp hip/groin pain.

exercises.name: Knee-to-Chest Release
instructions: Lie on your back on a comfortable surface.
Draw one knee toward your chest, clasping your hands around the shin.
Keep the other leg relaxed and your lower back gently grounded.
Hold 20–30 seconds, then switch legs.
exercises.caution: Stop if you feel pain shooting down your leg or worsening back pain.

exercises.name: Upper Back Cat-Cow
instructions: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.
Inhale and drop your belly, lifting your chest and gaze (cow).
Exhale and round your upper back toward the ceiling (cat).
Flow slowly with your breath for 8–10 rounds.
